answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the jetty seed, the ocean timing is verifiable from the saffron record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. A farm that wants 69 keys thus pays 69 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 512 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
